scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently diagnosed the root cause of the build failure with minimal tool calls, correctly identifying the configuration mismatch caused by a missing project in the solution. The only gap is not explicitly listing all 42 projects, though the count was mentioned. The root cause analysis and fix suggestion are excellent.

rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with wrong config → output in wrong path
